messages.subject: processing large files
parts:
Hi all,

Suppose I have a large text file (several GB). I would like to make some processing using a Shiny app, where the file is not uploaded (the program does not make a copy into a temp folder), but the user picks a file with a "fileInput" control. When the user presses a "run" button, The application iteratively reads n lines of the file, makes some processing, and appends the fragment to the output file, processing in this way the whole document.
I cannot figure how to read recursively from the real path (without uploading the file). Any idea?

A toy example could be:

######################################
 ui <- fluidPage(
          fileInput(inputId = 'datafile', label = ''),
          br(),
         
          h3("The path:"),
          verbatimTextOutput("myText"),
         
          # the user here selects a name for the output
          textInput("selectOutput", label = h3("Output filename")),

          # run button
          actionButton("run", label = "run program and save")
          )
 
 
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
 
      filepath <- reactive({
      file <- input$datafile
      if(is.null(file)) return()
      return(file$datapath)
    })
     
      output$myText <- renderPrint({
        return(filepath())
      })
     
      observe({
        if(input$run == 0) {
          return()
        }
        isolate({
       # here perform some computations in chunks
       # and append the processed data to the output file
        })
      })

  }
 
  shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

###############

Any help would be appreciated, thanks!

  Leandro

I have found the solution using file.choose():

############################
 ui <- fluidPage(
   
        tags$div(
        actionButton("selection", "select a file"),
        h3("File selected:"),
        verbatimTextOutput("myPath")
        ),

actionButton("run", label = "Show me the next line and write it to the output!"),
        br(),
        h3("Line content:"),
        verbatimTextOutput("myText")

observeEvent(input$selection, {
      filepath <- file.choose()
      output$myPath <- renderPrint(filepath)
      con <- file(filepath, open="r")
      if(input$selectOutput != "") {
      file.create(input$selectOutput)

if(input$selectOutput == "") {
          output$myText <- renderPrint("Please select an output name first!")
          return()
          }
          x <- try(readLines(con,1), silent = TRUE)
          if(class(x) == "try-error") {
          return()
          } else if(length(x) != 0) {
          output$myText <- renderPrint(x)
          cat(x, file = input$selectOutput, sep="\n", append = TRUE)
          } else {
          try(close(con), silent = TRUE)
          output$myText <- renderPrint("End of file!")
